about_the_game:
In most space games you pilot a ship or colonize worlds. In this game, you are the celestial object instead. You start as a lone asteroid and grow by absorbing others, evolving step-by-step into a planet, a star, and finally an all-consuming black hole in a vast, physics-driven sandbox.

Absorb smaller asteroids to accumulate mass and evolve through cosmic stages. Every stage brings new abilities and challenges. For example, as a planet you can nurture life and shield your world from danger. As a star, your powerful gravity captures planets into orbit. As a black hole, you devour everything in your path.

Experience realistic gravity and orbital mechanics in a true sandbox environment. Form planetary systems by having moons and asteroids orbit around you, or fling your orbiting bodies as gravitational weapons to smash rival systems. There are no boundaries – drift freely through an infinite universe that evolves dynamically with every collision.

The game also features real-time online multiplayer, bringing the cosmic sandbox to a shared universe. Cooperate by linking orbits with other players to create multi-star systems and protect each other, or compete by crashing into rivals to steal their mass and dominate the starfield. Whether you form alliances to build a harmonious cluster or become a lone predator of the cosmos, the fate of this living galaxy is in the players’ hands.

Key Features:

  • Cosmic Growth: Progress from a tiny asteroid to planet, star, and finally black hole, each stage with unique gameplay and abilities.

  • Realistic Physics: True-to-life gravity simulation lets you create stable orbits or wreak havoc by colliding with other celestial bodies.

  • Dynamic Universe: An open-ended sandbox with no edges – new asteroids, planets, and events continually emerge as your cosmic journey unfolds.

  • Multiplayer Interaction: Shared online universe where every celestial body could be another player. Ally with friends or challenge others in epic gravity-fed battles.

  • Choose Your Playstyle: Peacefully cultivate life on your planets and grow together, or become a destructive force that annihilates all in your path.
